items.title: Ultimate Spaceship Base
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Live on this flying spaceship base and make it your own! On this spaceship base you will find:

+ Enchanting room
+ Land to space teleporter
+ Armory
+ Brewing room
+ Storage area
+ Crafting zone
+ Smelting area
+ Tree farm
+ Nether portal
+ Villager trading area
+ Mob XP farm
+ Cobble generator
+ Sugar cane and cactus farm
+ Spaceship command room
+ Animal farms

items.title: Demonic Castle
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Welcome to Demonic Castle. The classic Minecraft castle has been invaded by demons and dragons. Set up camp, Equip yourself, and get ready to conquer it back. But beware of the massive dragon defending it. Will you be able to free the castle from its evil grasp?

+ Massive mob infested demonic castle 
+ 200 block-sized dragon
+ Tamable dragon and boss
+ 3 demonic skins

items.title: Summer 2021
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Summer 2021 is here, meaning you're finally free to go outside with your friends! Go and play football, host a pool party, or forget about school and play skyblock all day. Use your freedom and 2021 skin pack to dominate skywars, take a plane and go on vacation to explore our now freed world. What will you do this summer?

+ 12 summer 2021 skins
+ 1 free summer 2021 skin

items.title: Castle Skyblock
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Your castle and kingdom have been banished to the sky. Live in your skyblock castle, parkour to skyblock islands, dive in mob ridden dungeons with zombies, and re-conquer your (not so fallen) skyblock kingdom.

Includes: floating castle, multiple islands, farmer's market, cobble generator, brewing, storage and cooking areas, guide book, and more!

items.title: Weapons Alive!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Weapons have come alive with arms, legs, and loads of expressions to choose from!
Grab this Weapons Alive pack and laugh and meme with your friends!

+ 17 Weapons Alive skins!
+ 2 free skins!
+ Includes diamond sword, golden pickaxe, and iron shovel skins!

items.title: Millionaire Island Getaway
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to live on your own private island? Now is your chance! Enjoy this giant luxury mansion with a private pool, beach, and equipped with all the best gear! Bring your friends along and live as millionaires!

+ Private island
+ Massive mansion
+ Enchanted netherite armor
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Best Friends
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Tired of your old skins and are looking for something that's new and trendy? You're in luck! The best friend's skin pack offers just the thing for you, with a wide range of colorful skins and outfits to improve your fashion! Pick your favorite and play your favorite maps and servers in style!

- 12 skins
- By inPixel
